description: This file defines the interface 'BankingService' which specifies methods related to banking operations such as managing customers, accounts, transactions, and transfers.

classes.name: BankingService
classes.description: A Java interface defining the contract for banking operations such as customer management, account management, transfers, and transaction retrieval.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Adds a new customer with the provided customer details.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds customer details based on customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer details for the specified customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes the customer identified by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds account information based on account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for a given customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs a transfer operation for a given customer.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves transactions associated with a specific account number.
